localized_incident AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id,incident_key,source_id,external_id,CASE title WHEN 'CRAC-02: снижена холодопроизводительность; температура R12 29,4 °C' THEN 'CRAC-02: reduced cooling capacity; R12 inlet temperature 29.4 °C' WHEN 'Кратковременная потеря связи' THEN 'Brief connectivity loss' ELSE title END AS title,severity,detected_at,owner_team_id,response_due_at FROM dcmon.incident), p AS ( SELECT ${INT(p_system)}::bigint system_id,${INT(p_env)}::int env_id, ${INT(p_software)}::bigint software_id,${INT(NVL(p_server,0))}::bigint selected_id, ${INT(NVL(p_site,0))}::bigint site_id, greatest(1,${INT(p_page)}::int) requested_page, '2026-10-21 14:32:00+03'::timestamptz at ), -- param: resolve external IDs and reject invalid system/software/environment filters. param AS ( SELECT p.*,sy.ci_key system_key,sp.code software_code, CASE env_id WHEN 1 THEN 'PROD' WHEN 2 THEN 'TEST' WHEN 3 THEN 'DEV' END environment FROM p LEFT JOIN dcmon.information_system s ON s.ci_id=p.system_id LEFT JOIN localized_ci sy ON sy.ci_id=s.ci_id LEFT JOIN dcmon.software_product sp ON sp.id=p.software_id WHERE (p.system_id=0 OR s.ci_id IS NOT NULL) AND (p.software_id=0 OR sp.id IS NOT NULL) AND env_id BETWEEN 0 AND 3 ), -- all_paths: union application execution paths with compute inventory only for all systems/environments. all_paths AS ( SELECT e.server_id,e.node_ids FROM param p CROSS JOIN LATERAL dcmon.execution_paths(p.at) e WHERE (p.system_id=0 OR e.system_key=p.system_key) AND (p.env_id=0 OR e.environment=p.environment) UNION SELECT cp.server_id,cp.node_ids FROM param p CROSS JOIN LATERAL dcmon.compute_paths(p.at) cp WHERE p.system_id=0 AND p.env_id=0 ), -- paths: intersect path members with the active site placement and software installation scope. paths AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT a.* FROM all_paths a CROSS JOIN param p WHERE (p.site_id=0 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dcmon.device_placement placement JOIN dcmon.room room ON room.ci_id=placement.room_id WHERE placement.device_id=a.server_id AND room.site_id=p.site_id AND tstzrange(placement.valid_from,placement.valid_to,'[)') @> p.at)) AND (p.software_id=0 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dcmon.software_installation si JOIN dcmon.installation_placement ip ON ip.installation_id=si.ci_id AND tstzrange(ip.valid_from,ip.valid_to,'[)') @> p.at WHERE si.product_id=p.software_id FROM paths ), -- seeds: expand each path into starting nodes for infrastructure dependency traversal. seeds AS ( SELECT DISTINCT server_id,unnest(node_ids) node_id FROM paths ), -- walk: traverse active power/cooling/network/storage providers; prevent cycles and cap paths at 32 nodes. walk AS ( SELECT s.server_id,s.node_id,ARRAY[s.node_id] visited FROM seeds s UNION ALL SELECT w.server_id,d.provider_id,w.visited||d.provider_id FROM walk w JOIN dcmon.dependency d ON d.dependent_id=w.node_id CROSS JOIN param p WHERE d.dependency_type IN ('power','cooling','network','storage') MATERIALIZED ( SELECT s.* FROM param p CROSS JOIN LATERAL dcmon.status_snapshot(p.at) s JOIN hosts h ON h.server_id=s.ci_id ), -- facts: one row per selected server with active location, m.metric_code='power_w') power_w, max(m.display_value) FILTER(WHERE m.metric_code='cpu_pct') cpu, max(m.display_value) FILTER(WHERE m.metric_code='memory_pct') memory, max(m.display_value) localized_ci c ON c.ci_id=h.server_id JOIN dcmon.device dev ON dev.ci_id=h.server_id CROSS JOIN param p LEFT JOIN states st ON st.ci_id=h.server_id LEFT JOIN dcmon.device_placement dp ON dp.device_id=h.server_id AND tstzrange(dp.valid_from,dp.valid_to,'[)') @> p.at LEFT JOIN localized_ci rack_ci ON rack_ci.ci_id=dp.rack_id LEFT JOIN dcmon.room room ON room.ci_id=dp.room_id LEFT JOIN localized_ci room_ci ON room_ci.ci_id=room.ci_id LEFT JOIN localized_ci site_ci ON site_ci.ci_id=room.site_id LEFT JOIN metrics m ON m.ci_id=h.server_id GROUP BY h.server_id,c.ci_key,c.name,st.state,room.site_id,dp.rack_id,site_ci.name,room_ci.ci_key,rack_ci.ci_key, dp.u_start,dp.u_height,dev.model,dev.cpu_cores,dev.memory_gib ), -- ranked: stable throughput' WHEN 'Скорость вентилятора' THEN 'Fan speed' WHEN 'Влажность' THEN 'Humidity' WHEN 'Температура на входе' THEN 'Inlet temperature' WHEN 'Занято RAM' THEN 'RAM utilization' WHEN 'Потери в коммутатора' THEN 'Switch temperature' ELSE name END AS name,unit,metric_type,valid_min,valid_max,warning_above,critical_above FROM dcmon.metric_definition), p AS ( SELECT ${INT(p_system)}::bigint system_id,${INT(p_env)}::int env_id, ${INT(p_software)}::bigint software_id,${INT(NVL(p_server,0))}::bigint selected_id, ${INT(NVL(p_site,0))}::bigint site_id, greatest(1,${INT(p_page)}::int) requested_page, '2026-10-21 14:32:00+03'::timestamptz at ), -- param: resolve external IDs and reject invalid system/software/environment filters. param AS ( SELECT p.*,sy.ci_key system_key,sp.code w.server_id,d.provider_id,w.visited||d.provider_id FROM walk w JOIN dcmon.dependency d ON d.dependent_id=w.node_id CROSS JOIN param p WHERE d.dependency_type IN ('power','cooling','network','storage') AND tstzrange(d.valid_from,d.valid_to,'[)') @> p.at AND NOT d.provider_id=ANY(w.visited) AND cardinality(w.visited)<32 ), -- events: propagate active incidents to selected servers using their latest
